stem.text: The diagram shows two coplanar forces, $P$ and $Q$, drawn to scale.

stem.alt: Two arrows labelled P and Q: arrow P points right, arrow Q points down and to the right.

stem.text: Force $R$ is given by $R = Q - P$.

B.alt: Arrow from lower right to upper left.
